title: trending-local-llms posts contract
description: JSON Schema that data/posts.json must conform to. Keyed by source_post URL -> {date, likes, comments, reshares, views, interactions}. Engagement published ONCE per post; measurement rows reference it by source_post instead of restating it (issue #689 — the #463/#525 loss class). Enforced by scripts/validate.py.

additionalProperties.description: Counters are optional per row (a real mirror page may not report views). An absent counter resolves to 0 on the flattened measurement row — never a penalty.
